mechanics.name: Premonition
mechanics.currentEffect: While not being chased by the Killer, whenever you look in the Killer's direction within 32 metres, you are notified and see the Killer's Aura for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 55/50/45 seconds.
activation: Look in the Killer's direction while they are within 32 metres.
Ends/deactivates when: The Aura reveal ends after 3 seconds.
Ends/deactivates when: The perk cannot trigger during its 55/50/45-second cooldown or while you are being chased.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Reworked to trigger while not chased when looking toward the Killer within 32 metres, reveal the Killer's Aura for 3 seconds, and use a 55/50/45-second cooldown.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Outside chase, looking toward a nearby Killer gives a notification and a brief Aura reveal.
specialInteractions: The former 45-degree detection-cone field is removed; final 10.2.0 live text uses 'look in the Killer's direction'.

editorial.summary: While not in chase, looking toward a Killer within 32 metres gives a warning and reveals their Aura for 3 seconds.
useCases: Check whether a nearby Killer is actually on the side of the structure you suspect.
Get a short Aura confirmation before committing to a generator or rescue.
Detect nearby stealth Killers when the trigger conditions are satisfied.
counters: It does not trigger while you are already in chase.
A 45-second Tier III cooldown is long.
Three seconds of Aura information is modest compared with stronger information perks.
pros: Now gives real Killer Aura information.
Simple warning for Solo Q and newer players.
Can help against nearby stealth approaches.
analysis: Premonition received the rework it needed. Instead of a vague directional ping on a short cooldown, the live 10.2 version gives a clear notification and three seconds of Killer Aura when you look toward a nearby Killer outside chase.
That makes the information much easier to act on. A short Aura is enough to confirm which side of a wall the Killer occupies or whether a suspicious approach is real.
The forty-five-second Tier III cooldown is the limiting factor, and the perk shuts off in chase where Killer information often matters most.
Premonition is therefore improved beginner and Solo Q awareness, not a top information perk. It finally answers a concrete question instead of merely making the player nervous.
editorial.verdict: Much healthier in 10.2: a real three-second Aura read instead of a cryptic ping. Useful awareness, still limited by a long cooldown and no chase activation.
